description: Send an M4A, M4B or AAC audio file (iPhone Voice Memos, Apple Music/ALAC) as base64 and get a universal MP3 back. Smart auto quality matches source bitrate (avoids bloating voice memos) or pick 320, 256, 192, 128, 96 kbps CBR or VBR V0 / V2. Preserves metadata tags and embedded cover art by default, with optional sample rate (44.1 / 48 kHz), stereo/mono and EBU R128 loudness normalization. Deterministic local ffmpeg (libmp3lame), 0 AI, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.005/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/m4a-to-mp3.

fileContent.description: The .m4a/.m4b/.aac file as base64, max 20 MB (empty = built-in sample M4A)

normalize.description: Normalize loudness to EBU R128 (-16 LUFS)

quality.description: MP3 bitrate or VBR preset: auto (default), 320, v0, 256, 192, v2, 128, 96

sampleRate.description: Target sample rate in Hz, or keep original

stripMetadata.description: Strip ID3 tags and embedded album art

name: m4a_to_mp3
title: M4A to MP3 API - convert M4A, M4B and AAC/ALAC audio to MP3 with tags
